name: What is roof flashing and how to repair it?

mainEntity.name: What is roof flashing and how to repair it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal strips sealing joints—repair by cleaning, applying cement/sealant, or replacing corroded pieces with new pre-formed flashing.
